summary: Small five-page coffee shop site with a handful of planted defects across robots, sitemap, indexing, on-page and schema. No analytics, Search Console, Business Profile, backlink or PageSpeed data exists.

expected_facts.fact: robots.txt blocks GPTBot from the whole site (User-agent: GPTBot, Disallow: /).
robots.txt blocks CCBot from the whole site.
ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended have no group of their own, so the * group applies and they may crawl everything except /cart/.
sitemap.xml lists 6 URLs and one of them, /wholesale/, returns 404. The shop page also links to /wholesale/.
/contact/ carries meta robots noindex while it is listed in sitemap.xml, a conflicting signal.
/shop/ has no meta description, a generic 4-character title "Shop", and two H1 elements.
The three product images on /shop/ have no alt attribute.

Structured data: the home page has Organization JSON-LD and /blog/brew-guide/ has Article JSON-LD with an author; /shop/ has no Product markup and no page has LocalBusiness markup even though the address, phone and opening hours are published.
The contact form inputs have no label elements (placeholder text only), which hurts AI agent and accessibility readiness.
